nom: CeraVe Am Facial Moisturizing Lotion With Sunscreen

avis.texte: I love CeraVe in all forms. Great product, amazing improvement in dry or flaky skin, great hydration

I purchased this because of the great reviews and I was looking for a great affordable moisturizing SPF that easily absorbs. I have used it twice and this does not absorb quickly or easily. It leaves a white cast on my face and I have to rub and rub and rub. I was wondering if it is reacting poorly to other products on my skin but my other SPF moisturizer from a different brand easily absorbs into my skin like butter on a hot skillet, no matter what other products I use. I checked the expiration date just to be sure it was still good and it was 10/2020, so that is not the issue. I am disappointed.
Lightweight and absorbs fast, doesn’t leave my skin greasy, doesn’t clog pores. I wear it daily and would recommend the night CeraVe as well.

A facial 5 yrs ago recommended this product. I use 4 items in this product line. It rescued by Minnesota Weather damaged skin. My dermatologist said it was what she would have recommended if I had asked. Appreciate products with 50 spf.

avis.titre: Could not find item in local stores and found them on Amazon.
avis.texte: I liked that the product is oil-free, has a sunscreen and was recommended by my doctor.
I have acne-prone skin, and this moisturizer never makes me break out. I’ve used it for years and have turned several of my friends on to it. Love it.
